text:
talia: Canary rollout v3.3.0 -> eu-west-1 completed. Kicking off post-deploy smoke (lite tokenization + structured checks + kv-warmup). Watching for 20m.

deploy-bot: canary applied at 2% traffic. readiness OK, invoking smoke-lite.

monitor-bot: smoke-lite interim: 10/10 token checks OK, p50=36ms p95=92ms errors=0. KV warmup hit-rate lower than baseline: 78% vs expected ~95%.

evan: small cluster of 502s observed on prefiller-eu at 16:10:12 UTC, sample logs: 
```
16:10:10 prefiller-eu-1 req=aa1 status=200 t=34ms
16:10:12 prefiller-eu-2 req=aa2 status=502 t=68ms reason=upstream_timeout
16:10:14 prefiller-eu-1 req=aa3 status=200 t=33ms
```

meenal: Correlate shows kv-write queue spike on the same hosts at 16:09:58 (qdepth 6x). Could be warmup ordering regression in v3.3.0.

talia: Proposal: pause global ramp. Pin embed & non-critical kv-backed routes in eu-west-1 to v3.2.7. Keep canary at 2% for 30m while we collect metrics. Thresholds: if prefiller 502 rate <= 0.2% and kv hit-rate >= 90% for 10m -> advance to 20% staged ramp. If 502 rate >0.5% for 5m OR any structured-output assertion errors -> rollback to v3.2.7. Add release note line: "v3.3.0: observed kv warmup variance; holding ramp for investigation."

deploy-bot: rollout paused by talia. pin set: eu-west-1 -> v3.2.7 for kv/embedding routes at 2% until 3740002911.

ops-bot: alert rule created: `alert:prefill.502.rate > 0.5% for 5m` -> notify #oncall. Also created dashboard note.

evan: Quick mitigation: scaling prefiller on canary hosts now: `kubectl scale deploy/prefiller --replicas=6 -n eu-west-1-canary` and reducing prefill concurrency: `kubectl set env deploy/prefiller PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=3 -n eu-west-1-canary`. Will monitor.

monitor-bot: post-mitigation metrics (2m after): prefiller 502s cleared (0 in last 2m), kv hit-rate climbed to 91% after pod warmup. No structured failures observed in extended suite so far (running full-coverage now, ETA ~10m).

talia: Good. Decision: keep canary pinned at 2% and hold global ramp for 30m. Owners: evan (mitigation & nodepool checks), meenal (logs & regression debug), ops-bot (alerts & dashboard). Reconvene in 15m or earlier on any threshold breach.

ops-bot: note: scheduling staged ramp for tomorrow change window 07:00 UTC if metrics remain stable.
